root_cause.text: The `mod_hdcp_read_rx_id_list` function in the AMD display driver fails to clamp the HDMI HDCP2 receiver ID list message size (`rx_id_list_size`) to the size of the destination buffer (`rx_id_list`), allowing an out-of-bounds write during the I2C read.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff replaces `hdcp->auth.msg.hdcp2.rx_id_list_size` with `MIN(hdcp->auth.msg.hdcp2.rx_id_list_size, sizeof(hdcp->auth.msg.hdcp2.rx_id_list))` in `mod_hdcp_read_rx_id_list()`, and the CVE description states that the message size field was used as the read length without being clamped to the size of the destination buffer `rx_id_list[177]`.
